name: Blood Bound
summary: Hidden-role vampire clan duel where wounds reveal clues; capture the enemy leader to win for your clan.
rules_text: Shuffle half the Rose clan cards and half the Beast clan cards (equal numbers for even player counts) and deal one hidden character to each player. Each character has a clan, a rank number (lowest is leader), affiliation icons, and a clue icon shown only to left neighbor. Place rank tokens and affiliation tokens in supply. Random player gets dagger and is active. On a turn active player must either attack another player or pass the dagger to any player. Attacked player suffers a wound before dagger moves: he takes from supply one token matching an icon on his card (rank or affiliation) and places it visible; fourth wound captures him and ends game. Before wounding, any player whose rank token is still in supply may offer to intervene; target may accept one. Intervener must take his rank token as the wound and becomes new active player. After taking rank, a player may use his character ability. If final capture is the rival clan's leader, attacker's clan wins; otherwise attacker's clan loses and rival clan wins.
rating_reason: Social deduction 6-12p, hidden clan roles, attack to reveal identities.
